mythology: Sati's neck (Griva) fell upon the dense Nallamala forest mountain; Devi took the form of billions of bees (Bhramara) to slay demon Arunasura who held a boon of invulnerability against two and four-legged beings.
pilgrimage_significance: One of only two shrines in India hosting both a Jyotirlinga and a Shakti Peetha; Adi Shankaracharya composed Sivananda Lahari and Bhramaramba Ashtakam here.
historical_notes: Mentioned in the Mahabharata, Matsya Purana, and Agni Purana; sanctuary for great masters like Nagarjuna, Allama Prabhu, and Akka Mahadevi.
